fusions.name: Spilled Arcana
fusions.desc: Looses 3 sparks of raw mana and flame that spread apart, each dealing 6 damage, with a 20% chance to leave the target [Exposed] for 5 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Unstable Ignition
fusions.desc: Throws a mote of unstable mana that deals 18 damage and uses up every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Raw Infusion
fusions.desc: Increases your fire damage by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Brimming
fusions.desc: When your mana is full, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 10 seconds.
